errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the main purpose and grouping variable of the chart, which is "Възможност за избор на работно място" (Opportunity to choose a workplace), divided into two panels: "НЕ" (No) and "ДА" (Yes). It incorrectly describes the chart as a simple comparison between working from home and from the office.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са оцветени в зелено за работа от вкъщи и в синьо за работа от офис.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The colors are not mapped to the work location. The green bars correspond to the "НЕ" (No choice) group, and the blue bars correspond to the "ДА" (Yes choice) group.

errors.text_span: Стойността на мотивацията за работа от вкъщи е приблизително 18, докато за работа от офис е около 34.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly implies there is only one bar for "От вкъщи" and one for "От офиса". The chart actually shows two bars for each of these categories, separated into two panels ("НЕ" and "ДА"). This sentence completely misrepresents the structure of the data.

errors.text_span: за работа от офис е около 34
errors.evidence: The value provided for "работа от офис" (work from office) is incorrect. The chart shows two bars for this category with approximate values of 24 (in the "НЕ" group) and 41 (in the "ДА" group). The value 34 does not correspond to either bar.

errors.text_span: Нивото на мотивация за работа от офиса е по-високо от това за работа от вкъщи, което е отразено във височината на стълбовете.
errors.evidence: The generation prompt explicitly forbids making comparisons ("не сравнявайте стойности"). This sentence makes a direct, generalized comparison that also oversimplifies the data by ignoring the two different contexts (with and without choice).
